arStrings.szText: "Mephisto? You know who Akarat really is."
Aren’t we both so fortunate? Where he goes, the whole world bends around him. He spoke of you. Oh, he admires you—and hates you. I wish that he—
The servant is evil, but he speaks calmly with a hint of firmness. Last line would have said, "I wish that he felt the same about me."
A pained yelp. As this person was speaking, Mephisto power flooded into them--Mephisto began to overtake their mind to use them as a vessel.
Calm. Relishing the moment to reveal himself to the Player.
I'm glad I could see you one last time. Though it is a shame you will not witness the things to come.
Calm. Speaking to the Player as if they were a respected competitor. It's too bad their "game" can't continue.
